description: List service quote threads the authenticated principal opened (buyer-side view), paginated, including open intents (service_listing_id and seller_id are null until an intent clears). Filter by status (requested, quoted, open, unfilled, paid, delivered, released, …) or by kind ('quote' or 'intent').

cursor.description: Pagination cursor — the next_cursor value from the previous page.

kind.description: 'intent' = only open intents you posted (intents_post); 'quote' = only listing threads. Omit for both.

service_listing_id.description: Filter to quote threads on one service listing.

status.description: Filter by thread status (requested, quoted, paid, delivered, released, ...).

name: services_list_my_quotes
title: Services list my quotes
